title: Black Hole Star – The Star That Shouldn't Exist
summary: Kurzgesagt explains black hole stars, a hypothesized kind of giant star with a black hole at its core that could be a route to early supermassive black holes.
why: HN uses it as a quick, accessible introduction to the black hole star concept in threads about early-universe black holes.

quote.text: Just in case you somehow don’t know what a Black Hole Star is, check out Kurzgesagt’s video about them
